entries.4bfe74e89843a80f: It operates in an environment where the importance of domestic resource circulation is rising as countries position critical minerals strategically. By region, revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥28,963 million in Japan and ¥15,466 million overseas; the overseas figure includes Korea, Vietnam, South America and others. In the information by major customer, SEAH BESTEEL is shown as a customer of the Global Trading Business.
entries.502b07fd9a21a9f4: Its long-term vision, 'En-Vision2035', aims to become a comprehensive circular economy platform company that regenerates waste into valuable resources and takes on the whole of society's resource circulation, with the fiscal year ending June 2036 as the target. To this end, it states that it will play three roles: connecting those who supply resources with those who use them, producing green materials through low-carbon processes, and supporting resource circulation in local communities. The key strategic businesses positioned as growth pillars are three: the Gold and Silver Slag Business, the Lithium-Ion Battery Recycling Business and the Polymer Circular Economy Business.
